Juvenes Dogana.svg|150px|thumbnail|right|Former club crest]] '''A.C. Juvenes/Dogana''' is a [[San Marino|Sammarinese]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Dogana]], in the civil parish of [[Serravalle (San Marino)|Serravalle]]. The club was founded in [[2000 in association football|2000]] after the merger of '''S.S. Juvenes''' (named after a historical side in [[San Marino]]) and '''G.S. Dogana'''. Until season 2006/07 Juvenes/Dogana was the only team to play in both Sammarinese and [[Italy|Italian]] leagues, taking part in the ''Girone A'' of [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio|Campionato Sammarinese]] and in the Italian amateur levels, but it has since retired from the Italian leagues.[http://www.figc-dilettanti-er.it/archivio.php?id=2&nextrow=&file=444 Emilia Romagna Amateur football yearbook 2007/08] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090521191550/http://www.figc-dilettanti-er.it/archivio.php?id=2&nextrow=&file=444 |date=2009-05-21 }} The team's colors are light blue, red and white."}}
